_comment: 全站 SEO 元数据的唯一来源。改 title / description / 域名都改这里，然后跑 npm run seo。
_locales_comment: 英文是主语言，占住根目录；中文在 /zh/ 下。x-default 指向英文。静态托管做不了根目录 301，所以英文必须在根，不能放 /en/ 再跳转——那会把最值钱的 URL 浪费在一个跳转页上。
_org_comment: Organization / WebSite 结构化数据。英文品牌描述是给 Google 和 AI 系统读的。

organization.name: Earthory
organization.description: Earthory is an AI memory platform that helps people capture, search, recall and understand their real-world experiences.
organization._sameAs_comment: 官方社交账号。我不知道你们真实的账号地址，所以留空——填假 URL 会让 Google 判定这个 Organization 不可信。开通后填进来，跑 npm run seo 就会写进所有页面。

_pages_comment: 每页两种语言各一套 title / description。path 是不带语言前缀的路径，生成时会自动加上。

en.title: Earthory | AI Memory — Search and Recall the Real World
en.description: Earthory is an AI memory platform that helps people capture, search, recall and understand their real-world experiences, connecting people, places, objects, events and moments into memory you can verify.

zh.title: Earthory｜AI Memory · 记住现实，找回人生
zh.description: Earthory 是一家 AI 记忆公司，让现实生活可以被记录、搜索和回忆。把人物、地点、物品、事件和时刻串成你随时能找回、也能核对的记忆。

en.title: Earthory One | AI Memory Device for the Real World
en.description: Earthory One is a 360° reality sensing device. Multimodal sensors and local-first processing turn what you see and hear into structured, searchable personal memory.

zh.title: Earthory One｜AI 记忆硬件，让现实变成能查的记忆
zh.description: Earthory One 是一颗 360° 现实感知设备。多模态传感与本地优先处理，把看到听到的变成结构化、可检索的个人记忆。

en.title: Earthory App | Search Your Real-World Memories
en.description: Ask your own past a question: where the keys ended up, who was actually there. Earthory App uses semantic search across your timeline to retrieve what really happened.

zh.title: Earthory App｜搜索并回放你的现实世界记忆
zh.description: 向自己的过去提问：钥匙最后出现在哪、那天到底谁在场。Earthory App 用语义检索在时间线上找回真实发生过的事。

en.title: How It Works | Turning Reality into Searchable Memory
en.description: Four layers from reality happening to helping you grow: One for sensing, Hub for local processing, Memory OS for long-term understanding, and ST-VDB, the spatiotemporal vector database.

zh.title: 工作方式｜Earthory 如何把现实变成可搜索的记忆
zh.description: 从现实发生、形成记忆、长期理解到帮助成长的四层结构：One 现实感知、Hub 本地处理、Memory OS 长期理解，以及时空向量数据库 ST-VDB。

en.title: Privacy & Security | Data Boundaries | Earthory
en.description: Three sensing modes, six commitments, where data goes, and the privacy centre. No training, no selling. Stop, revoke, audit and forget are all in your hands.

zh.title: 隐私与安全｜Earthory 的数据边界与感知模式
zh.description: 三种感知模式、六条底线、数据去向与隐私中心。不训练、不出售，停止、撤回、审计、遗忘都在你手上。

en.title: Plans & Pricing | Earthory AI Memory
en.description: Choose by setting, storage capacity and retention: five tiers from personal and family to commercial spaces, industrial sites and enterprise, or configure it for your own site.

zh.title: 计划和定价｜Earthory AI 记忆方案
zh.description: 按场景、存储容量和记忆保存周期选择：个人、家庭、商业空间、工业现场到企业级五档，也可以按自己的现场自定义配置。

en.title: Careers & Partnerships | Earthory Singapore
en.description: Ten partnership tracks and eight role families, based in Singapore. Looking for engineers, researchers, creators, channel partners and product integration partners.

zh.title: 加入我们｜Earthory 新加坡团队与合作通道
zh.description: 十条合作通道与八个岗位家族，办公室在新加坡。找工程师、研究者、创作者、渠道与产品接入伙伴。

en.title: Download Earthory App | Android Preview Build
en.description: The Earthory App Android preview build is open for download. No invite code and no hardware needed. Install it and try asking your own past a question.

zh.title: 下载 Earthory App｜安卓体验版
zh.description: Earthory App 安卓体验版开放下载，不需要邀请码也不需要硬件。安装后即可体验向自己的过去提问。
